title: Foreleg scythe
concept: Scythes (forelegs mutation, proposed): bone sickle blades growing from the front legs.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single curved bone sickle blade on its own, like a mantis's raptorial blade carved from ivory: a thick dark brown chitin socket at one end, a long slender pale bone blade curving into a hooked point, a serrated inner edge with small backward teeth, side view, no insect, no body. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 800 triangles, 512 maps. Rigid, on a foreleg's tibia; one mesh for every scythed leg (mirrored).
